about.title: About Us | Sample Interiors Studio
about.metaDescription: Sample Interiors Studio is a Bengaluru-based interior design and modular kitchen studio with 8+ years of experience.
about.bodyHtml:
Sample Interiors Studio has been designing kitchens and homes in Sample Layout and nearby areas of Bengaluru for over 8 years. We work directly with each family, from the first site visit to the final handover, so there is always one point of contact and no surprises on the bill.

We source materials locally, keep a small team so quality stays consistent, and show you exactly what you are paying for before work begins.
